fato_historico: 1862: American Civil War: Confederate spy Belle Boyd is arrested by Union troops and detained at the Old Capitol Prison in Washington, D.C.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle release of past tensions, much like a prisoner finally stepping into the sunlight after a long confinement. It is a good time to reconsider your personal boundaries. Consider nurturing your emotional landscape with grace, allowing yourself to let go of old defenses and embrace the warmth of fresh, supportive connections.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the courage to release what no longer serves your spirit.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of inner wisdom and the pursuit of truth.
conselho: Prioritize your peace of mind by setting firm boundaries with grace today.
